## Mission

Be a project in the conditions Perry's own board is not in, so the contract
pages that describe those conditions can be checked against a payload.

## Operating Principles

- Every finding here is derived by the real tool from the real files below.
- Nothing here is written into the payload by hand.

## Anti-Goals

- Not a second Perry. This project exists to be read, never to be worked.
